text: Yes, the JRC map supports the claim of tree-cover loss in 2023. The Hansen Global Forest Change data shows a tree-cover loss of about 0.7 hectares within the asset in 2023. This observation is corroborated by the JRC GFC2020 data, which agrees on the entire event area being forest in 2020. The loss is confirmed to be within the asset boundary and is supported by the observational data.
